description: Successful dystopian map with isometric-lite perspective
prompt_used: pixel art game exactly copying stardew valley viewing angle, ground tiles flat from above, all buildings and objects showing front faces not roofs, post-apocalyptic suburban neighborhood, broken houses with visible doors and windows, cracked pavement with grass, abandoned cars from 3/4 view, research lab building damaged but standing, dead trees showing trunks, debris scattered on ground, dystopian but recognizable as earth suburb, no people no NPCs no characters
notes: This produced a nice 'isometric-lite' or '3/4 perspective' view similar to The Last of Us. Ground is mostly top-down with buildings at a gentle angle showing fronts. Good dystopian feel without being too destroyed.
